notes:
• Duplicates: LitArbi now recognises the same document twice — identical files by content hash, probable twins by title or near-identical text with the same page count. An orange badge marks them in the list (hover for the twin), the sidebar gains a “Duplicates” view, the import review warns “identical file already in this matter” and skips it by default, and Tools ▸ Duplicates lists every group with “Select All But First” + “Move Selected to Trash”. Nothing is deleted permanently; files shared with a kept exhibit are never removed.
• Releases carry a name from now on — this one is Geneva; About, the splash screen and this dialog show it.
name: Geneva
